claims.text: The models were evaluated on the CSAT dataset, which consists of US English telephone speech from call centers.
The 20 newsgroups dataset was used for topic identification, containing approximately 20,000 documents across 20 topics.
The Fisher Phase 1 corpus was also used for topic identification, consisting of spoken transcripts.
